items.problem: ShieldGemma 2 is an image-only safety classifier (Vertex docs: 'Checks the safety of synthetic and natural images'). The general capability in the question and explanation, evaluating prompt inputs and output responses against defined safety policies, is how the docs describe the ShieldGemma family ('Evaluate the safety of prompt input and output responses against a set of defined safety policies'), not ShieldGemma 2 specifically. As written, the explanation misdescribes ShieldGemma 2. Also, gemma.ai lists two EmbeddingGemma versions, so the 'EmbeddingGemma 2' distractor may be a real model name; it is still wrong for this task.
items.proposedFix: Option A (keep answer): question 'A company wants an open model to check generated and natural images against its safety policies. Which Gemma variant fits?' correctAnswer 'ShieldGemma 2'; explanation 'ShieldGemma 2 is a 4B model built to label images for safety, used as an input filter for vision language models or an output filter for image generation.' Option B (keep question): correctAnswer 'ShieldGemma'; explanation 'ShieldGemma is a set of instruction-tuned open models that evaluate the safety of prompt inputs and output responses against defined safety policies.' Distractors: 'EmbeddingGemma', 'Gemma 4', 'MedGemma'.
